Before broad exploration in this repository, read .github/reviews/codebase-review.md and .github/reviews/local-change-review.md first.

Use those review documents as the primary starting context for new chat sessions. Only read additional source files when the task needs file-level detail, when the review docs are stale, or when the changed files are not covered there.

When code changes affect behavior, architecture, security, API contracts, build tooling, or major data flow, update .github/reviews/codebase-review.md.

For normal day-to-day commits, rely on .github/reviews/local-change-review.md for incremental updates and read the files listed in the newest entries before expanding to the wider codebase.
